Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with B/KB/MB/GB units and one decimal place
- **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — converts to lowercase, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters
- **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches users from the API, logs the count using the log() function from logger.js, and returns the array
